summary: The image loader-diag-xnu-ne2-usb: NAT-067's md0 image that ran the project's PID 1 on the phone in NAT-068 (same loader, kernel, ADT and probe-init ramdisk) with the tag NAT069-md0 and ' e1sdisp=2' appended, so that the pinned display patch maps seven display register windows and prints a read-only dump after the framebuffer report. Its derived driver, an analyser that reads the dump into a scan-out fork, 39 host tests, 63/65 mutants killed (2 equivalent), decision 0029 drafted. Nothing ran on the phone.
evidence_category: host-test (derivation by asserted text substitution, static reads of the real payload kernel and the pinned display patch, the derived driver/analyser against temporary trees, text rendered from the patch's own format strings and the real NAT-068 kernel log). No android-userland and no native-device evidence; the synthetic display readings are not measurements.

acceptance.1_build: build.py loads NAT-065's build and replaces the image name, the nat_attempt tag and the appended boot-args; two builds (build-001, build-002) give identical hashes; the command line is NAT-067's with NAT067-md0 -> NAT069-md0 and ' e1sdisp=2' appended (237 bytes, under the 256-byte field); every input is pinned by SHA-256 (build.json nat065_pins, carried unchanged from NAT-067); the build refuses a command line that already has e1sdisp.
acceptance.2_tests: test_nat069.py (39 tests, 0 skipped: Build, Payload, Kernel, Package, Driver, Display, Analyser): the loader Image differs from NAT-067's in five immediate words, the XNU payload only in the command-line field (11 bytes), the ramdisk not at all; the patch's format strings are the ones the analyser reads and the payload kernel carries them; the pipeline function makes only ml_io_map, one-load e1s_display_read and printf calls and every offset read lies inside the mapped window; the committed driver equals derive.py's output; the gates refuse a missing/ambiguous decision file, a missing hash or 'decision 0019', native unset or citing another file, and each undone required task; the analyser reads each scan-out fork and the non-findings (cannot-map, partial, framebuffer-only, none) from text rendered from the patch's formats, the real NAT-068 log as framebuffer-only with root outcome probe-ran-to-exit, and does not accept another image's boot.
acceptance.3_mutants: mutants.py: 65 mutants (src B/D/S/A/M, patch P1-P8, artifacts X1-X4); 63 killed, 2 equivalent (D9, M10, reasons in mutants.py), none survived, none invalid.
acceptance.4_decision_draft: decision-draft.md names both hashes (RECOVERY 5abd8943..., Image.payload 192de4b6...), decision 0019, the question/observable/decision this run feeds, the seven display windows (plus DSIM1) with bases and sizes, the read-only claim and its test, the risks (synchronous external abort, SError, a bus hang ended only by the 83 s watchdog), what stays unknown, the pass rule (chain PASS plus a complete reading in display.fork), and records no run-specific owner confirmation (standing statements of decisions 0025/0026 cited); nothing ran on the phone; every 64-hex string in it was checked against the build/package records or the files.

established: Host-test: the image is reproducible (two builds identical) and differs from NAT-067's, which ran PID 1 on the phone, only in five loader immediates and the 11-byte command-line difference of the XNU payload (ADT, kernel and ramdisk unchanged).

Host-test: the boot-arg e1sdisp is the one the pinned patch parses (default 1 = framebuffer report, 2 = pipeline dump); the pipeline function only reads (ml_io_map, one 32-bit load per register, printf) and every offset lies inside its mapped window.

Host-test: the analyser classifies a complete dump into one of five scan-out readings and keeps cannot-map, partial, framebuffer-only and no-text distinct from them; each reading carries the caveat that register values do not show what the panel presents.
Host-test: the derived driver and analyser cannot be used for another image or without the decision file naming both hashes and decision 0019.
not_established: Whether the seven display windows are readable in the loader's power/clock state (a gated block can raise a synchronous abort or SError, or hang the bus until the 83 s watchdog).
What the registers contain, and whether the patch's register layout (UI-007's derivation from pinned Samsung source) matches the silicon.
That the panel shows the loader's framebuffer or CPU writes to it, that any frame can be presented, anything about the GPU or about Apple userland.
A PID 1 that stays alive and the timed loader_return_after=8 return (NAT-071/NAT-072).
findings: The NAT-068 log contains only the default report: framebuffer 1080x2340 depth 32 stride 4320 phys 0xfa200000; the register dump has never run on the phone.
A format-string-rendered dump lets the analyser be tested field for field without a measurement; the first reading that matters is the one NAT-070 returns.

A mutant that read a pipeline with missing RDMA lines as complete (M5) survived the first mutation run until a test with a missing middle line was added (test_a_pipeline_with_a_missing_line_in_the_middle_is_partial).
